english.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that something is not natural or seems artificial.
Use this when someone feels or behaves uncomfortable and unnatural in social interaction.
Use this when a situation, behavior, or arrangement feels unnatural or out of place rather than manufactured.

examples.english: The way they speak sounds very unnatural.
examples.traditional: 佢講嘢個語氣好唔自然。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 go3 jyu5 hei3 hou2 m4 zi6 jin4

examples.english: I always feel awkward when I chat with my new colleagues.
examples.traditional: 我同新同事傾計嗰陣成日覺得唔自然。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 san1 tung4 si6 king1 gai2 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 gok3 dak1 m4 zi6 jin4

examples.english: Arranging the seats this way feels artificial.
examples.traditional: 咁樣安排啲座位好唔自然。
examples.jyutping: gam2 joeng2 on1 paai4 di1 zo6 wai2 hou2 m4 zi6 jin4
